ModMetaData.name: Arsenal - Fallout NV Weapon Pack - French TradFix
ModMetaData.author: ZIOM
ModMetaData.description:
The weapons of Fallout: New Vegas for the Arsenal series: 215 weapons from the Mojave Wasteland, from frontier revolvers to pre-War energy weapons.
Contents: - Firearms: pistols, revolvers, rifles, lever-actions, submachine guns, shotguns, machine guns and sniper rifles. - Energy weapons: laser, plasma, Gauss, Tesla, sonic and flame weapons, including unique variants. - Explosives and launchers: grenades, dynamite, satchel charges, grenade rifles, missile launchers and the mini-nuke launchers. - Melee and unarmed: knives, blades, blunt weapons, throwing weapons, power and shock gloves, fuel blades, chainsaws and more. Weapons are spread across tech tiers from early frontier to pre-War high technology. Special weapons never spawn on enemies or caravans.
Requires Arsenal - Core. Has its own workbench; research follows the Arsenal era chain together with vanilla research.
Compatible with Combat Extended (CE) and Muzzle Flash (optional).
Languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Russian.
Weapon names are used for identification only.
